approach: One-condition fix in reconcileOfflineReceipts(): `if (delivery === 'settled' || delivery === 'held') settlements += 1;` (was `delivery !== 'replayed'`), route comment updated to state the budget counts DURABLE decisions only. Bound on RPC work per request is unchanged in kind: every entry under the 2 MB body cap may reach the RPC (as replays already could after r8); each pending/replay RPC is an indexed lookup under the owner lock. Regression 'a queue of receipts the database defers under a reversible freeze never starves the fresh receipt behind it': 250 chargeable Pro receipts under a frozen active release (p_defer_new=true → pending, nothing durable) re-presented ahead of one receipt delivered without output (evidence_missing HOLD) across 2 drains → 251 RPC calls each drain, the HOLD recorded on drain 1 and replayed on drain 2, durable.size 1; freeze lifts → 250 settle (spending the budget, the HOLD entry is answered pending by the cap for that one drain), next drain → whole queue replays with 251 RPC calls. Coordinator proof: with the index.ts change stashed the new test FAILS (1 failed), with it `ok | 2 passed` (with the r8 HOLD-starvation test).

residual_risks: Per-request settlement budget (OFFLINE_RECEIPT_BATCH_SETTLE_MAX=250) still exists for DURABLE decisions: after a freeze lifts, a queue of >250 deferred receipts settles 250 per drain; an already-durable entry queued behind them is answered pending by the cap for that drain and replays on the next — bounded delay, not starvation (pinned by the new test).
RPC calls per request are bounded only by the 2 MB body cap (~1200+ entries at ~1.6 KB each) when a queue is all replays/pending — same bound r8 already accepted for replays.

Mobile drain still POSTs every queued receipt in one body; >2 MB gets 413 until chunked on the device — mobile-side, tracked in the W04-04 r9 competing lanes (impl-r9-c2 adds <1 MB chunking in apps/mobile/src/data/api.ts) / W05-07.

summary: W04-04 r10 = coordinator follow-up ON TOP OF the integrated r8 (6441f505 merged as 4373cf4d on the integration branch). Fixes the verify-8 adversary P1: a batch entry the database answers `pending` (deferred under a reversible deny-new freeze, or shot.session_not_found) writes nothing, yet the route counted it against OFFLINE_RECEIPT_BATCH_SETTLE_MAX, so 250 pending entries starved the fresh receipt behind them on every drain (settle_offline_receipt called 250 times, fresh never reached, durable rows 0). Now only durable decisions (delivery settled|held) spend the budget; replays and pending answers are free.
